# Flights

British Airways has announced London Gatwick to Zanzibar via Kilimanjaro from 29 May 2027, three times a week.
Air Tanzania will begin London Gatwick flights on 1 July 2027.
Condor flies non-stop from Frankfurt to Zanzibar in winter.
TUI is planned to start London Gatwick to Zanzibar on 3 November 2027.
